title: Monk armor
wikitext: {{TOCright}} A full set of '''[[Monk]] armor''' consists of a scalp design, vestments (or raiment), handwraps, pants and sandals. A set of tattoo armor contains a scalp design, chest design, arm design, leg design and foot design. ==Armor bonuses== [[Basic armor|Basic]] Monk armor provides up to a maximum of 60 [[Armor rating|armor]], 10 extra [[energy]] and 2 extra [[energy recovery]].
